title: Plan: new platform features
blurb: All 678 features that chromestatus.com lists for Chrome 130 to 160, each with a note on how it combines with a canvas that draws live DOM, and all 33 planned demos built from those notes.
question: Which features from Chrome 130 to 160 can be combined with a canvas that draws live DOM, and what happens when I build demos from them?
result: 359 of 678 features have an idea, 44 are measured by probes, and all 33 planned demos are built.
